name: A Solo: Timothy Ridout
description: Enjoy a free classical concert in the serene setting of São Bento Monastery. Violist Timothy Ridout performs a solo recital—a perfect, peaceful end to a busy weekend.
longDescription:
A Solo: Timothy Ridout presents a classical music recital featuring violist Timothy Ridout. This free event showcases Ridout, a British violist recognized for his solo performances and chamber music collaborations. He has performed with orchestras internationally and is known for his interpretations of both established and contemporary repertoire. The concert offers an opportunity to hear a solo program within a historic Porto setting.

Attendees will experience a tranquil evening of classical music. The performance takes place in the Mosteiro de São Bento, a venue known for its architectural significance and serene atmosphere, which complements the nature of a solo viola recital. The event is designed to provide a peaceful conclusion to the weekend, suitable for those seeking a moment of calm and musical reflection. The concert is open to all members of the public interested in classical music.

This event is free to attend, with no prior booking required. Visitors are welcome to walk in. The Mosteiro de São Bento is located in central Porto, within walking distance of São Bento train station and the São Bento metro station. It is also accessible via various bus routes serving the city center.
